canada.title: I went to DEFSEC Atlantic. All I got was a (lousy) violation of my Charter rights
canada.summary: Midway through the second day, organizers revoked my badge and banned me for ‘unsafe behaviour’ in a troubling violation of the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms.

canada.title: Ontario cancer patients speak out over disappointment with drug funding decision
canada.summary: Some Ontarians with Stage 4 cancer, whose doctors say they are good candidates for treatments unavailable in the province, were buoyed last month when a man won a court challenge against his OHIP out-of-country denial. But their hopes were dashed when Health Minister Sylvia Jones responded to the court ruling by changing the rules.

canada.title: Communities take over Fort St. John airport operations after 30 years of private management
canada.summary: Local communities in northeast B.C. are set to take over operations at Fort St. John's regional airport after 30 years of private management.

canada.title: Anonymous attendee prompts new rules for Haines Junction online council meetings
canada.summary: Several Yukon communities have seen silent online accounts attend council meetings. Haines Junction is moving ahead with new rules that would let officials ask attendees to show there's a person behind the screen.

canada.title: Man dead in ‘chaotic’ Richmond Hill fire that resulted in homes, vehicles ablaze
canada.summary: It was a “chaotic scene” with three cars fully engulfed in flames between the two houses that were also ablaze, fire crews told reporters Wednesday.

canada.title: N.W.T. expands home heating subsidy for seniors
canada.summary: The N.W.T. government announced changes to the Senior Home Heating Subsidy Wednesday, with the aim of allowing more seniors to access financial assistance with home heating costs over the winter.

canada.title: Sask. premier says province will seek alternatives after cancelling CWD testing program
canada.summary: Premier Scott Moe says the province's plan to pull testing for chronic wasting disease (CWD) in harvested game animals was a budget decision.

canada.title: Mayoral candidate Kevin Klein says Winnipeg property taxes will rise to pay for 100 more police officers
canada.summary: Winnipeg mayoral candidate Kevin Klein says property taxes will rise to help pay for his promise to add 100 more police officers.

canada.title: Winnipeg-based rescue techs parachuted into Wainwright after deadly military base fire
canada.summary: Nearly a dozen search and rescue personnel from Winnipeg were among those deployed to Alberta when a deadly fire engulfed a training exercise at CFB Wainwright on Saturday.

canada.title: Report says Quebec food banks facing historic demand, over 3M service requests a month
canada.summary: Demand on the network's services is up five per cent since last year, and roughly 40 per cent since 2021.

canada.title: Encampments to be part of this year's point-in-time homelessness count in Prince Albert
canada.summary: Last year's Prince Albert point-in-time homeless count found 279 people were living on the street. Organizers estimate the numbers will be even higher this year, as the annual survey will now include people living in homeless encampments throughout the city.

canada.title: New calf born to endangered southern resident orcas in B.C.
canada.summary: Researchers say the male calf was spotted in waters near B.C. twice this week, and is likely less than a week old.

canada.title: Wainwright residents pay their respects as soldiers leave town following deadly training exercise
canada.summary: People from across the community of Wainwright, Alta., lined the highway that cuts through town Wednesday morning to pay their respects to some of the soldiers at the centre of a weekend tragedy that left four dead and dozens more injured.

canada.title: Mobile ministry bus is hitting St. John's roads, offering warm drinks and more
canada.summary: The Anglican Church community is going mobile, offering people a place to get warm, have a meal and pull on winter clothing. Rev. Amanda Taylor hopes it will be on the road this fall.

canada.title: Calgary fire crews battle blaze outside southeast Calgary business
canada.summary: Investigators have determined a blaze outside of a liquidation centre in the city's southeast started amid some furniture behind the building before making its way inside.

canada.title: Appeal of an N.S. RCMP officer’s sexual assault acquittal has been abandoned by Crown
canada.summary: An appeal of a Nova Scotia RCMP officer's sexual assault charge acquittal has been abandoned by the Crown.

canada.title: Province directs Vitalité to send nurses filling ER vacancies back to primary care
canada.summary: Vitalité Health Network says it still needs help in an understaffed emergency room in northern N.B., despite the province telling it to return nurses it pulled from primary care back to their roles.
